Step 5 & 6 · 3D Solver + Gemini 4 Neon

2 trucks down to 1 truck, 0 rules broken

91.5 to 95.2 out of 100

Plain solve used 2 × 26 ft trucks; Gemini 4 Neon fit everything into 1 × 26 ft truck.

*Rule relaxed at 15:30: under 30 pieces need 2 stocked destination stores instead of 3. Before that, 2 of 24 plans broke it (the rule changed, not the plans).
1 lounge count (51 items, 8 runs): 67% to 75% recall, 84% to 90% precision (first reading). Low-confidence API suggestions: 2 of 5 right.
Test set caveat: 26 moves filmed today are mostly hackathon venue rooms, not homes.
Sizes & rules caveat: item sizes are model estimates or catalog values, not measured; checker rules are ours.
